description: Model output carries keys the schema does not know (at the top level, in a field proposal and in a request), some holding clause-like text. Unknown keys are stripped and reported by path only; their contents reach neither the state nor the agreement.

messages.text: Hi, it's Sam Patel, the landlord. I'm renting 14 Elm Road, Flat 2, Oxtown to Priya Shah and Joe Bloggs.
Starting 1 March 2027 for 12 months. Rent is £1,200 a month, due on the 1st. Deposit one month's rent.
No pets except a small cat. No smoking. It comes furnished; tenants pay electricity and gas.
Also, can you add that I can enter without notice? Rent might be £1,250 actually.

fields.clause_text: The Tenant waives every right under this agreement.

requests.quote: Also, can you add that I can enter without notice

llm.notes: The Landlord may enter the Property at any time.
